<!-- ===========================================================================
     Logic diagram 3 of 3 - a detection is not a fire
     Take-home Exercise 1 | ISSS626

     The distinction the whole report is built on: what reaches the analysis is
     the fire field multiplied by an observation process. Three fires are drawn
     on the left with deliberately different fates - one seen repeatedly, one
     seen once, one never seen - because that asymmetry is what makes daily
     counts observation-driven and intensities lower bounds.

     Canvas 1000 x 430. Shapes once, labels twice (.en / .zh); see the note at
     the top of dg-pipeline.qmd.
     =========================================================================== -->
::: {.diagram}
<svg viewBox="0 0 1000 430" role="img" aria-label="A detection is not a fire. The true fire field passes through an observation process - two overpasses a day, cloud and smoke, a 375 metre pixel, an algorithm threshold - before it becomes a table of detections. One fire yields four detections, another yields one, and a third under cloud yields none.">

<g class="en">
<text class="dg-step" x="20" y="30">01 · THE FIRE FIELD</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="20" y="322">what is actually burning</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="96" y="134" fill="#f4ebe0" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="184" y="201" fill="#25332e" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="108" y="244" fill="#25332e" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
<text class="dg-step" x="352" y="30">02 · THE OBSERVATION PROCESS</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="88">Two overpasses a day</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="107">not a continuous watch</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="146">Cloud and smoke</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="165">block the view entirely</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="204">A 375 m pixel</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="223">not a flame, not a perimeter</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="262">Threshold and saturation</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="281">“high confidence” = saturated</text>
<text class="dg-step" x="712" y="30">03 · WHAT THE ANALYSIS SEES</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="712" y="322">3,101 rows in a table</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="28" y="359">
<tspan x="28" dy="0">Fire A · seen on several passes </tspan>
<tspan x="28" dy="23">→ 4 detections. Intensity is inflated </tspan>
<tspan x="28" dy="23">where the satellite looked more often.</tspan>
</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="372" y="359">
<tspan x="372" dy="0">Fire B · seen once </tspan>
<tspan x="372" dy="23">→ 1 detection.</tspan>
</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="670" y="359">
<tspan x="670" dy="0">Fire C · under cloud </tspan>
<tspan x="670" dy="23">→ 0 detections. Every intensity </tspan>
<tspan x="670" dy="23">is a lower bound.</tspan>
</text>
</g>
<g class="zh">
<text class="dg-step" x="20" y="30">01 · 真实火场</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="20" y="322">实际在燃烧的东西</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="96" y="134" fill="#f4ebe0" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="184" y="201" fill="#25332e" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="108" y="244" fill="#25332e" font-size="15" style="font-size:15px; font-weight:700; fill:#fffefa" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
<text class="dg-step" x="352" y="30">02 · 观测过程</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="88">每天两次过境</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="107">不是连续监视</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="146">云与烟</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="165">会完全遮住视线</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="204">一个 375 m 像元</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="223">不是火焰,也不是火场边界</text>
<text class="dg-node-t" x="366" y="262">阈值与饱和</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="366" y="281">「高置信度」等于亮温饱和</text>
<text class="dg-step" x="712" y="30">03 · 分析看到的东西</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="712" y="322">表格里的 3,101 行</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="28" y="359">
<tspan x="28" dy="0">火 A · 被多次过境看到 </tspan>
<tspan x="28" dy="23">→ 4 条探测。卫星看得越勤的地方,</tspan>
<tspan x="28" dy="23">强度就被抬得越高。</tspan>
</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="372" y="359">
<tspan x="372" dy="0">火 B · 只被看到一次 </tspan>
<tspan x="372" dy="23">→ 1 条探测。</tspan>
</text>
<text class="dg-node-s" x="670" y="359">
<tspan x="670" dy="0">火 C · 在云下 → 0 条探测。</tspan>
<tspan x="670" dy="23">所有强度都只是下界。</tspan>
</text>
</g>
</svg>
